title: SuperTags - Revolutionizing Phygital Experiences
tagline: Redefining brand-customer relationships by creating interactive, engaging experiences that seamlessly blend the tangible and virtual worlds for brands.
description:
SuperTags offers an innovative phygital (physical + digital) solution, seamlessly blending the tangible and virtual worlds for brands. SuperTags is not just transforming products; it's redefining brand-customer relationships in the phygital realm.

With each tap of a smartphone, consumers can access a rich digital landscape of product histories, exclusive content, and tailored offers, elevating their experience beyond the physical.

**Links**
- [https://shachindra.github.io/SuperTags/index.html](https://shachindra.github.io/SuperTags/index.html)
how_its_made: There were quite a few hiccups while building this project. Connecting the Flutter App with the Webapp to transfer the NFC UUID was a difficult part that I was able to accomplish through making the NFT Mint and NFT Unique ID linked through the Mobile App Itself. I also ran into issues with gasless mint of NFTs for brand/business owners since they might not be having the technical know how to acquire tokens for Gas.
